name: Franco-Arabic, typed the way people actually type on a phone
note: Latin letters and numerals standing in for Arabic sounds — 3 for ع, 7 for ح. The rules require two dialect or slang cases and the corpus had none. Cross-script matching is an embedding property and retrieval already found the koshari; what is tested here is that the judgement reads the request at all rather than refusing because it does not look like Arabic.
